title: Slug-based titled clues with Start gating, rich paste support, and Windows Aero theme

requirements.text: Update the clue data model and APIs to support: (a) a human-readable URL path segment ("slug") per clue, (b) a title per clue, and (c) rich content per clue, while preserving existing clue order so there is a well-defined "first clue".

quotes: there should also be a title to each clue
each clue except the first one should be solved by replacing the word after /
Add a Create Clue button for generating a new clue tied to a URL

acceptanceCriteria: Backend stores each clue as a structured record containing at least: slug, title, and content.
Backend provides a way to create a clue with slug+title+content (admin-only as today).
Backend provides a way to fetch a clue by slug (authenticated user as today).
Backend provides a way to list clues in a stable order that identifies the first clue (authenticated user as today).
Existing numeric clue URLs remain possible by treating existing clues as having slugs like "1", "2", etc. (see migration requirement).

requirements.text: Add conditional state migration so existing deployed clue data (currently stored as plain Text per incremental Nat ID) is preserved when upgrading to the new clue record format.

quotes: there should also be a title to each clue

acceptanceCriteria: If existing clue state is present, migration converts each existing clue into the new record format without data loss.
Migrated clues have deterministic slugs that keep old URLs working (e.g., slug = "1" for old clue id 1).
Migrated clues have a non-empty title (e.g., "Clue #1") and content equal to the previous stored Text.

requirements.text: Change frontend routing and clue loading so clues are opened via the path segment after `/echofields/` (slug), e.g. `/echofields/something`, not only numeric IDs.

quotes: each time i should be able to give this something which opens the given clue

acceptanceCriteria: The route `/echofields/$clueId` is updated to accept a slug value (string) and fetch the clue by slug.
Visiting `/echofields/something` loads and displays the clue associated with slug `something` if it exists.
If the slug does not exist, the page shows a clear "Clue Not Found" error (English) without crashing.

requirements.text: Display each clue’s title on the clue page and in any relevant lists/labels, using English user-facing text.

quotes: there should also be a title to each clue

acceptanceCriteria: CluePage shows the clue title prominently (e.g., as the CardTitle) instead of only "Clue #...".
Admin clue list shows each clue’s title alongside its slug/path.
No user-facing labels for title are left blank when title exists.

requirements.text: Implement Start gating for the first clue: the first clue must remain hidden until the user presses a Start button on the main (/echofields) page; if there are zero clues, the Start button must not show and must not function.

quotes: First clue stays hidden until Start is pressed on the main page
If there are zero clues, Start won’t show or work
also only make the first clue appear if we press the start button in the main web
if there are no clues at all, no start buttons will do

acceptanceCriteria: On `/echofields`, a single Start button is shown only when at least one clue exists.
When there are zero clues, the Start button is not rendered and there is no other CTA that navigates to the first clue.
Pressing Start sets a session-scoped flag (e.g., sessionStorage) that allows viewing the first clue for that browser session.

If a user tries to open the first clue directly without pressing Start in that session, the clue content is not shown; instead show a locked/prompt state with a button/link back to the home page to press Start.
Non-first clues are not blocked by the Start gating.

requirements.text: Update the clue navigation UX so that for clues after the first, users can progress by entering just the next slug (the word after `/echofields/`) and opening the corresponding clue (i.e., construct `/echofields/{slug}` automatically).

quotes: each clue except the first one should be solved by replacing the word after /
i should be able to give this something which opens the given clue

acceptanceCriteria: CluePage provides an input that accepts a slug value (e.g., "something") and navigates to `/echofields/something` on submit.
The UI still supports pasting a full internal path like `/echofields/something` (and navigates correctly).
Entering an external URL continues to be validated and opened in a new tab when allowed by existing URL safety rules.

requirements.text: Extend the admin create-clue workflow to include an explicit "Create Clue" button that creates a new clue tied to a URL slug, and include inputs for both slug and title.

quotes: Add a Create Clue button for generating a new clue tied to a URL
there should also be a title to each clue
add a button named create clue which works for the url

acceptanceCriteria: Admin create form includes inputs labeled in English for: Title, URL segment (slug), and Content.
The submit control is clearly labeled "Create Clue".
Slug is shown/previewed as a path like `/echofields/{slug}` in the admin UI.
Client-side validation prevents creating a clue with an empty title or empty slug.
Client-side validation prevents slugs containing `/` (since it must be a single path segment).

requirements.text: Support copy/paste of videos, images, and PowerPoint links into the clue content area by detecting pasted URLs and auto-inserting the existing supported markup formats: Markdown image `![alt](url)`, video `{{video:url}}`, and PPT `{{ppt:url}}`.

quotes: able to copy paste videos,imgs and ppts in the area
i shoould be able to copy paste videos,imgs and ppts in the area

acceptanceCriteria: Pasting an image URL (e.g., ending in .png/.jpg/.jpeg/.gif/.webp) into the admin content textarea inserts or converts it into `![Image](URL)` (keeping existing text around the cursor intact).
Pasting a video URL (e.g., ending in .mp4/.webm/.mov) inserts or converts it into `{{video:URL}}`.
Pasting a PPT/PPTX URL inserts or converts it into `{{ppt:URL}}`.
If the pasted text is not a supported URL, it is pasted normally (no destructive transformation).
Preview tab continues to render pasted/inserted rich media via the existing RichClueContent component.

requirements.text: Apply a Windows Aero-inspired visual theme consistently across the website (home, clue pages, admin portal), including glass-like surfaces, soft gradients, and appropriate blur/transparency while keeping text readable in both light and dark modes.

quotes: Add a windows aero look to the total website

acceptanceCriteria: Cards/panels use a glassmorphism style (translucent background + backdrop blur) with subtle borders and highlights.
Primary buttons, inputs, and key containers visually match the Aero style (consistent across Home, CluePage, AdminPage, Header, Footer).
The theme remains accessible/readable (sufficient contrast) in the existing dark-mode setup (next-themes).

constraints: Backend must remain a single Motoko actor in backend/main.mo (no additional backend services).
Generate backend/migration.mo only if required for upgrading existing state; migration must be conditional and preserve old data.
Do not modify files under frontend/src/components/ui (compose them instead).
Do not modify immutable hook bootstrap files (frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts, frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts, frontend/src/main.tsx).
Use English for any user-facing text.
nonGoals: Implementing third-party authentication providers beyond Internet Identity.
Uploading/storing binary files (images/videos/ppts) on the backend; this change is limited to pasting links/URLs into clue content.
Adding external databases or non-Motoko backend services.
